const filtersObject = {{v_component_stored_message__matter_filter}} ? {{v_component_stored_message__matter_filter}} : null;
if (filtersObject === null || filtersObject === undefined) {
  return null
}
const {
    opposing_firms_filter: { selectedValues: opposingFirms },
    firm_primary_assignee_filter: { selectedValues: primaryAssignees },
    outside_counsel_filter: { selectedValues: outsideCounselRaw },
    offer_of_judgment_filter: { selectedValues: offerOfJudgment },
    pre_lit_demand_filter: { selectedValues: preLitDemand },
    pre_lit_repurchase_offer_filter: { selectedValues: preLitRepurchaseOffer },
    case_name_filter: { selectedValues: caseNames },
    case_number_filter: { selectedValues: caseNumbers },
    legal_assistant_filter: { selectedValues: legalAssistants },
    case_handler_filter: { selectedValues: caseHandlers },
    assigned_status_filter: { selectedValues: assignedStatuses },
    current_phase_filter: { selectedValues: currentPhases },
    venue_filter: { selectedValues: venues },
    venue_state_filter: { selectedValues: venueStates },
    model_filter: { selectedValues: models },
    model_year_filter: { selectedValues: modelYears },
    primary_vin_filter: { selectedValues: primaryVins },
    trial_date_filter: { fromDateValue: trialDateFrom, toDateValue: trialDateTo },
    current_serve_date_filter: { fromDateValue: serveDateFrom, toDateValue: serveDateTo },
    offer_of_judgment_serve_date_filter: { fromDateValue: offerServeDateFrom, toDateValue: offerServeDateTo },
    pre_lit_demand_date_filter: { fromDateValue: preLitDemandFrom, toDateValue: preLitDemandTo },
    actual_spend_min_filter: actualSpendMin,
    actual_spend_max_filter: actualSpendMax,
    case_age_user_input_filter: caseAge, 
    case_age_user_dropdown_filter: {selectedValues: caseAgeDimension},
    matter_tags_filter: {selectedValues: matterTags},
    mcr_outcome_filter: { selectedValues: mcrOutcomes },
    mcr_completed_filter: { selectedValues: mcrCompleted },
    mcr_date_filter: { fromDateValue: mcrDateFrom, toDateValue: mcrDateTo },
    mcr_completion_date_filter: { fromDateValue: mcrCompletionDateFrom, toDateValue: mcrCompletionDateTo },
} = filtersObject

const filters = [
  caseNames?.length,
  caseNumbers?.length,
  caseHandlers?.length,
  legalAssistants?.length,
  primaryAssignees?.length,
  opposingFirms?.length,
  outsideCounselRaw?.length,
  assignedStatuses?.length,
  currentPhases?.length,
  venueStates?.length,
  venues?.length,
  modelYears?.length,
  models?.length,
  primaryVins?.length,
  Boolean(serveDateFrom && serveDateTo),
  Boolean(trialDateFrom && trialDateTo),
  Boolean(offerServeDateFrom && offerServeDateTo),
  Boolean(preLitDemandFrom && preLitDemandTo),
  actualSpendMin,
  actualSpendMax,
  caseAge,
  offerOfJudgment?.length,
  preLitDemand?.length,
  preLitRepurchaseOffer?.length,
  matterTags?.length,
  mcrOutcomes?.length,
  mcrCompleted.length,
  Boolean(mcrDateFrom && mcrDateTo),
  Boolean(mcrCompletionDateFrom && mcrCompletionDateTo),
] 

const isAnyFilterTrue = filters.some(condition => condition);

return isAnyFilterTrue;

const isUserFromExternalLawFirm = {{s_current_user_person_firm.data.outside_counsel.[0]}} ?? null

const configurationDates = {{ff_get_configuration_dates}} ?? []
const dormantCasesCalendarConfigDate = configurationDates.find(config => config.name === {{v_config_calendar_dormant_cases_name}})?.date ?? null

const dormantCaseDescription = `Dormant Cases are cases with the following criteria:
  1. The assignment status is "Open" or "In Progress"
  2. The case was assigned on or after ${moment(dormantCasesCalendarConfigDate).format('LL')}
  3. There has been no case progress in the last 60 days or more

What does no case progress mean?
  - There is no action item completed
  - There is no new settlement negotiation
  - There is no submitted case evaluation

By default, dormant cases are sorted in chronological order from oldest to most recent firm progress made (if any).`

const prefilters = isUserFromExternalLawFirm
? [
  {
    label: "Dormant Cases",
    exportlabel: "Dormant Cases",
    selection: "dormant_cases",
    icon: "moon",
    description: dormantCaseDescription
  },
  {
    label: "Upcoming Trials",
    selection: "upcoming_trials",
    exportlabel: "Upcoming Trials",
    icon: "time",
    description: ""
  },
  {
    label: "Cases Pending MCR",
    selection: "cases_pending_mcr",
    exportlabel: "Cases Pending MCR",
    icon: "outdated",
    description: ""
  }
]
: [
  {
    label: "Upcoming Trials",
    exportlabel: "Upcoming Trials",
    selection: "upcoming_trials",
    icon: "time",
    description: ""
  },
  {
    label: "Dormant Cases",
    exportlabel: "Dormant Cases",
    selection: "dormant_cases",
    icon: "moon",
    description: dormantCaseDescription
  },
  {
    label: "Pre-Lit Cases",
    exportlabel: "Pre Lit Cases",
    selection: "pre_lit_cases",
    icon: "take-action",
    description: ""
  },
  {
    label: "Cases Pending MCR",
    selection: "cases_pending_mcr",
    exportlabel: "Cases Pending MCR",
    icon: "outdated",
    description: ""
  }
]


return prefilters

functionInfos.body:
const caseEvaluation = transformColumnSchemaToRowSchema({{s_get_case_evaluation.data}})
const formatBoolean = (boolVal) => {
    if (boolVal === true) {
        return 'Yes'
    }
    else if (boolVal === false) {
        return 'No'
    }
    else {
        return null;
    }
}

const properties = caseEvaluation[0]
if (!properties) {
    return;
}
properties.status_tag = statusTag(properties.status)
properties.vehicle_condition = properties.vehicle_condition ?? '-'
properties.known_cpo = properties.known_cpo ?? '-'
properties.certified_pre_owned = formatBoolean(properties.certified_pre_owned) ?? '-'
properties.known_sale_price = properties.known_sale_price ?? '-'
properties.sale_price_formatted = formatCurrency(properties.sale_price)
properties.sale_price = (properties.sale_price ?? properties.sale_price_formatted) ?? '-'
properties.no_of_dealer_presentations = properties.no_of_dealer_presentations ?? '-'
properties.days_out = properties.days_out ?? '-'
properties.verification_status = properties.verification_status ?? '-'
properties.demand = properties.demand ?? '-'
properties.fee_demand_formatted = formatCurrency(properties.fee_demand)
properties.fee_demand = (properties.fee_demand ?? properties.fee_demand_formatted) ?? '-'
properties.details = properties.details ?? '-'
properties.trial_candidate = (typeof properties.known_trial_candidate !== 'undefined') ? (formatBoolean(properties.trial_candidate) ?? 'Need More Information') : '-'
properties.known_trial_candidate = properties.known_trial_candidate ?? '-'
properties.total_requested_settlement_authority_formatted = formatCurrency(properties.total_requested_settlement_authority)
properties.total_requested_settlement_authority = (properties.total_requested_settlement_authority ?? properties.total_requested_settlement_authority_formatted ) ?? '-'
properties.submitted_by = properties.submitted_by ?? '-'
properties.submitted_on = properties.submitted_on ?? '-'
properties.has_decision = Boolean(properties.decision)
properties.decision = properties.decision ?? '-'
properties.decided_by = properties.decided_by ?? '-'
properties.decided_on = properties.decided_on ?? '-'
properties.decision_reason = properties.decision_reason ?? '-'
properties.has_authority_details = caseEvaluationHasAuthorityDetails(properties)
properties.authority_formatted = caseEvaluationAuthorityFormatted(properties)
properties.authority = (properties.authority ?? properties.authority_formatted) ?? '-'
properties.authority_notes = properties.authority_notes ?? '-'
properties.assigned_decider = properties.assigned_decider ?? '-'
properties.assigned_firm = properties.assigned_firm ?? '-'
properties.created_by = properties.created_by ?? '-'
properties.created_on = properties.created_on ?? '-'

return properties
